text.en: Small helper verbs add shades of meaning to the main verb.

A துணைவினை is a verb that joins the main verb to add a meaning such as completion, continuity or ability. In 'he has eaten', the helper shows that the action is finished.
Common துணைவினைகள் include விடு, கொள், போ, வா, இரு, கொண்டிரு and முடி. They change only the shade of the meaning, and the main verb carries the main idea.
Practise finding the main verb and the helper in sentences. Remember that helper verbs lose their own full meaning when they help.
